entities.name: TAF1B/RRN7
observations: 582 aa protein; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Gallus gallus UniProt Q5ZJR9.
Predicted molecular weight is 67.31 kDa, theoretical pI 7.45, GRAVY −0.4225, and charge at pH 7 approximately +1.76.
Homologous to reviewed Homo sapiens Q53T94 and Bos taurus Q1JQD6 TAF1B/RRN7 proteins with approximately 54% identity over nearly the full sequence.
Pfam detects Zn_ribbon_RRN7 at residues 9–39, Rrn7_cyclin_N at residues 80–247, and Rrn7_cyclin_C at residues 264–456.
Annotated as a component of the RNA polymerase I core factor/SL1-TIF-IB complex in the nucleus and nucleolus.
Functions in Pol I preinitiation complex assembly, rDNA promoter recognition/recruitment, and nucleolar large rRNA transcription; acts as a GTF2B/TFIIB-like factor.
Reported interactions include TBP, TAF1A, TAF1C, and RRN3 in the Pol I transcription initiation machinery.

entities.name: RNA polymerase I initiation
observations: TAF1B/RRN7 participates in SL1/TIF-IB-dependent RNA polymerase I preinitiation complex assembly and large rRNA transcription.
